evidence.detail: The already-reviewed RaidInterfacePacketHandler handles selector 6 by reading one integer and passing it directly to rs/n/c/d/a.dD, the singleton rs/n/c/d/f instance, through rs/n/c/d/f.a(int).

Raid party construction places widget 32465 as raids/affbar1 directly beside the exact controls 'Add affliction tome(s)' and 'Remove affliction tome(s)', and RaidNavigationInterface registers rs/n/c/d/f as the overlay bound to widget 32465.

The overlay lazily loads raids/affbar2, renders the packet-driven value as a color-staged x/5 progress label, treats values >=5 as complete, and emits completion/progress particles on the same affliction bar.

candidates.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 raid affliction-tome progress behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
